# Ravenloft

Ravenloft applies a gothic parchment aesthetic in two matched variants, an aged-parchment Light and a midnight-library Dark. Its recorded design uses fonts with full Cyrillic and Latin coverage, six levels of colour-graded headings, ample whitespace and muted gothic red accents. Search highlighting is stated to work with Obsidian 1.6 and later.

![Ravenloft screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/circkumflexx/obsidian-ravenloft-theme/HEAD/preview.png)

Use hand-picked fonts with full Cyrillic & Latin coverage, six-level colour-graded headings, ample whitespace and muted gothic red accents for readable, atmospheric notes; supports Obsidian 1.6+ search highlighting."
